action_semantics.semantics: full native gradient clip, AdamW step, then scale actual LoRA A/B parameter displacement; Adam states advance normally
action_semantics.local: target displacement times scale; other displacement unchanged
action_semantics.global_norm: at this control own state, compute q=sqrt((norm(delta)^2-(1-alpha^2)*norm(delta_target)^2)/norm(delta)^2); apply q to all displacements; matches hypothetical local retained norm at own state, not another trajectory
action_semantics.zero_gradient: zero full displacement records q=1; no division by zero
action_semantics.full_effective_weight_caution: A/B parameter norm and step scaling do not equal effective BA norm or scaling
